en.text:
Today’s M&A briefing — one deal, the strategy behind it · 25 October 2026

🔹 Bregal Milestone (growth fund specializing in mid-market European technology and software companies) acquires a majority stake in Nethive.
The equity investment is accompanied by the simultaneous acquisition of JoyComm, a company intended to complement Nethive's base upon closing.
Our view: Bregal Milestone is not betting on Nethive as it is, but on what it can aggregate; JoyComm is less a target than a first argument for the thesis.
